project_info.theme: Alternate asset for the buy-two category catalog offer
project_info.color_palette: Near Black, Bright Yellow, White, Soft Cream, Red Ribbon Accent

main_subject.detail: An alternate source asset using the same split receipt-and-shelf system: a black left rail, torn offer receipt, gift-box prop, and three right-side product category shelves.
main_subject.style: Graphic ecommerce catalogue, reusable offer template, realistic packshot shelves

composition_elements.type: Offer receipt / product rows / gift prop
items: Left Center: Torn white receipt with yellow header, offer copy, and oversized discount.
Bottom Left: Red-ribbon yellow gift-box prop.
Right: Exactly three cream shelf compartments for REF_CATEGORY_ROW_1, REF_CATEGORY_ROW_2, and REF_CATEGORY_ROW_3.
Background: Pale yellow with precise white dividers.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean retail shelf shadows and high-contrast coupon typography

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity retail catalogue poster with graphic coupon panel

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: Rebuild the alternate Ultimate Sup buy-two catalog asset. Keep the fixed black left rail, torn white receipt, yellow gift box, and exactly three right-side cream product shelves. Replace logo, offer text, discount, gift label, and each product row through REF_BRAND_LOGO, {{BUY_GET_COPY}}, {{DISCOUNT_VALUE}}, {{GIFT_LABEL}}, and REF_CATEGORY_ROW_1/2/3. Preserve upright, label-facing packshots and clean white shelf dividers.
prompt.negative_prompt: more or fewer than three shelves, wrong logo, generic containers, distorted labels, illegible percentage, unapproved offer, low contrast, watermark

assets.name: Alternate receipt-and-shelf catalog layout
assets.usage: Use this asset as a separate reference file; preserve the same fixed three-row system.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: This file intentionally retains an alternate asset reference for the same template family. Keep exact campaign wording and packshot labels outside the image model when required.

substitutable_fields.replacement_rule: Swap rows independently without changing shelf count.
